From: DBY-W09 kernel-port draft
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] dt-bindings: ufs: allow dual power domains on SM8250

The pinned ACK qcom,ufs-common.yaml limits power-domains to one entry.
The DBY-W09 SM8250 UFS Host integration needs two independent domains:
RPMHPD MMCX followed by GCC UFS_PHY_GDSC.

Raise the shared ceiling to two, then use the compatible-specific condition
to keep all non-SM8250 Qualcomm UFS hosts at one. This intentionally allows
SM8250 hosts to use either the existing one-domain topology or the proposed
two-domain topology; it does not require two domains on every SM8250 board.

Draft only. Not applied, schema-validated or tested.

---
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml | 17 ++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 16 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@
       - const: ufsphy
 
   power-domains:
-    maxItems: 1
+    maxItems: 2
 
   required-opps:
     maxItems: 1
@@ -64,4 +64,20 @@
 allOf:
   - $ref: ufs-common.yaml
 
+  - if:
+      properties:
+        compatible:
+          contains:
+            const: qcom,sm8250-ufshc
+      required:
+        - compatible
+    then:
+      properties:
+        power-domains:
+          maxItems: 2
+    else:
+      properties:
+        power-domains:
+          maxItems: 1
+
 additionalProperties: true
--

From: DBY-W09 kernel-port draft
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] dt-bindings: ufs: share VDDP and VCCQ-parent supply schema

Describe the Qualcomm UFS reference-clock and VCCQ-parent supply metadata
in the shared qcom,ufs-common binding. The SM8250 controller is selected by
qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml in the pinned ACK tree, so common properties belong
in this shared schema rather than qcom,ufs.yaml. This avoids duplicate
compatible selection and makes the optional properties visible to both
Qualcomm UFS binding families.

Both maximum-load properties are required when their corresponding supply
phandle is present. Both load values must be positive. The VDDP driver
requests its configured load and enables the supply; VCCQ-parent remains
source-topology metadata and is not acquired by the initial ACK driver.

Apply after ROUND36. The original ROUND52 canonical patch is unchanged.
The shared binding keeps its existing strict unevaluatedProperties gates.

---
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml | 31 insertions(+)
 1 file changed, 31 insertions(+)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
@@ -1,83 +1,114 @@
-# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR BSD-2-Clause
-%YAML 1.2
----
-$id: http://devicetree.org/schemas/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml#
-$schema: http://devicetree.org/meta-schemas/core.yaml#
-
-title: Qualcomm Universal Flash Storage (UFS) Controller Common Properties
-
-maintainers:
-  - Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
-
-properties:
-  clocks:
-    minItems: 7
-    maxItems: 9
-
-  clock-names:
-    minItems: 7
-    maxItems: 9
-
-  dma-coherent: true
-
-  interconnects:
-    minItems: 2
-    maxItems: 2
-
-  interconnect-names:
-    items:
-      - const: ufs-ddr
-      - const: cpu-ufs
-
-  iommus:
-    minItems: 1
-    maxItems: 2
-
-  phys:
-    maxItems: 1
-
-  phy-names:
-    items:
-      - const: ufsphy
-
-  power-domains:
-    maxItems: 2
-
-  required-opps:
-    maxItems: 1
-
-  resets:
-    maxItems: 1
-
-  '#reset-cells':
-    const: 1
-
-  reset-names:
-    items:
-      - const: rst
-
-  reset-gpios:
-    maxItems: 1
-    description:
-      GPIO connected to the RESET pin of the UFS memory device.
-
-allOf:
-  - $ref: ufs-common.yaml
-
-  - if:
-      properties:
-        compatible:
-          contains:
-            const: qcom,sm8250-ufshc
-      required:
-        - compatible
-    then:
-      properties:
-        power-domains:
-          maxItems: 2
-    else:
-      properties:
-        power-domains:
-          maxItems: 1
-
-additionalProperties: true
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR BSD-2-Clause
+%YAML 1.2
+---
+$id: http://devicetree.org/schemas/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml#
+$schema: http://devicetree.org/meta-schemas/core.yaml#
+
+title: Qualcomm Universal Flash Storage (UFS) Controller Common Properties
+
+maintainers:
+  - Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
+
+properties:
+  clocks:
+    minItems: 7
+    maxItems: 9
+
+  clock-names:
+    minItems: 7
+    maxItems: 9
+
+  dma-coherent: true
+
+  interconnects:
+    minItems: 2
+    maxItems: 2
+
+  interconnect-names:
+    items:
+      - const: ufs-ddr
+      - const: cpu-ufs
+
+  iommus:
+    minItems: 1
+    maxItems: 2
+
+  phys:
+    maxItems: 1
+
+  phy-names:
+    items:
+      - const: ufsphy
+
+  power-domains:
+    maxItems: 2
+
+  qcom,vddp-ref-clk-supply:
+    description:
+      Supply for the UFS device reference-clock pad. The Qualcomm host
+      driver requests the configured load and enables this supply.
+
+  qcom,vddp-ref-clk-max-microamp:
+    minimum: 1
+    description: Maximum load requested from the UFS device reference-clock supply.
+
+  qcom,vccq-parent-supply:
+    description:
+      Legacy Qualcomm UFS host VCCQ-parent rail. This is a separate host
+      consumer supply and does not imply an enable or voltage request.
+
+  qcom,vccq-parent-max-microamp:
+    minimum: 1
+    description: Maximum load associated with the VCCQ-parent host consumer.
+
+  required-opps:
+    maxItems: 1
+
+  resets:
+    maxItems: 1
+
+  '#reset-cells':
+    const: 1
+
+  reset-names:
+    items:
+      - const: rst
+
+  reset-gpios:
+    maxItems: 1
+    description:
+      GPIO connected to the RESET pin of the UFS memory device.
+
+allOf:
+  - $ref: ufs-common.yaml
+
+  - if:
+      properties:
+        compatible:
+          contains:
+            const: qcom,sm8250-ufshc
+      required:
+        - compatible
+    then:
+      properties:
+        power-domains:
+          maxItems: 2
+    else:
+      properties:
+        power-domains:
+          maxItems: 1
+
+  - if:
+      required:
+        - qcom,vddp-ref-clk-supply
+    then:
+      required:
+        - qcom,vddp-ref-clk-max-microamp
+
+  - if:
+      required:
+        - qcom,vccq-parent-supply
+    then:
+      required:
+        - qcom,vccq-parent-max-microamp
+additionalProperties: true

From: DBY-W09 Stage-A implementation
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] dt-bindings: ufs: allow one or two SM8250 power domains

The generic dt-schema converter treats maxItems without an explicit
minItems as an exact-length tuple. ROUND36 raises the shared ceiling to
two, and its SM8250 conditional also needs an explicit lower bound.
Set both the shared property and the SM8250 then-branch to minItems: 1;
the non-SM8250 else-branch remains exactly one.

---
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,ufs-common.yaml
@@ -43,2 +43,3 @@
   power-domains:
+    minItems: 1
     maxItems: 2
@@ -92,4 +93,5 @@
     then:
       properties:
         power-domains:
+          minItems: 1
           maxItems: 2

--

From: DBY-W09 Stage-A implementation
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] dt-bindings: ufs: cap SM8250 clock-names at eight

The pinned ACK source already selects qcom,sm8250-ufshc through
qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml. Do not add that compatible to qcom,ufs.yaml:
doing so selects two independent strict schemas for the same node.

The SM8250 branch is the non-SC7180 branch in qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml.
It already requires at least eight clock names and limits clocks to eight;
cap clock-names at eight as well so the two arrays have matching cardinality.

This branch-local correction supersedes the misplaced ROUND32/ROUND57
qcom,ufs.yaml edits. It does not alter compatible selection or other SoCs.

---
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/ufs/qcom,sc7180-ufshc.yaml
@@ -100,3 +100,4 @@
         clock-names:
           minItems: 8
+          maxItems: 8
 
--

From: DBY-W09 Stage-A primary-source review
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] dt-bindings: phy: qcom-qmp-ufs: document vdda-phy-always-on

The SM8250 board firmware's UFS PHY overlay carries vdda-phy-always-on.
Document the optional boolean consumed by the companion QMP UFS PHY driver
change. The property is optional and is not required for other Qualcomm UFS
PHY nodes.

Candidate only. No dt_binding_check has run.

From: DBY-W09 Stage-A second-AI implementation
Subject: [PATCH DRAFT] kleaf: add DBY-W09 storage-first full kernel target

Add a no-base_kernel full custom kernel_build target for the pinned ACK
android17-6.18.33_r00 source. Copy the reviewed storage-first fragment into
the kernel source tree and apply it after gki_defconfig so Kleaf checks the
requested built-in values after olddefconfig.

The first target builds Image only. .config is exposed for the ROUND58
validator; System.map and vmlinux are retained for diagnosis. No DTB, DTBO,
boot image, module list, KMI enforcement, or base_kernel is declared.

Source: aosp-mirror/kernel_common@8ad08f75ddf056e1ee600e1339e0463c5fcbdc9a
BUILD.bazel blob: 3c8178ebce1f27f2c417e4aeaa00fc7001a96be6
Fragment source blob: ae8675357e2f5c57c9ec38e7574b00590b558c63

---
 BUILD.bazel | 19 +++++++++++++++++++
 arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment | 132 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 151 insertions(+)

diff --git a/BUILD.bazel b/BUILD.bazel
index 3c8178eb..00000000 100644
--- a/BUILD.bazel
+++ b/BUILD.bazel
@@ -1351,5 +1351,24 @@
     destdir = "out/yukawa/dist",
 )
 
+kernel_build(
+    name = "dby_w09",
+    srcs = [":kernel_aarch64_sources"],
+    outs = [
+        ".config",
+        "Image",
+        "System.map",
+        "vmlinux",
+    ],
+    arch = "arm64",
+    defconfig = "arch/arm64/configs/gki_defconfig",
+    make_goals = [
+        "Image",
+    ],
+    makefile = ":Makefile",
+    post_defconfig_fragments = ["arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment"],
+    visibility = ["//visibility:private"],
+)
+
 kernel_build(
     name = "fips140",

diff --git a/arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment b/arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment
@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+# DBY-W09 ACK android17-6.18 — storage-first built-in fragment
+#
+# DRAFT ONLY. Layer over a frozen ACK base config; do not use as a standalone
+# defconfig. Kconfig resolution has NOT been run and no kernel has been built.
+#
+# First milestone: enumerate internal UFS, then create Android logical partitions
+# and mount the confirmed EROFS vendor/odm filesystems. ROUND10 ramdisk module
+# layout is BLOCKED, so the complete UFS dependency chain stays built-in.
+#
+# This is an ACK-derived custom device-kernel fragment, not a certified GKI
+# config. Built-in composition can differ from the published GKI module ABI.
+
+CONFIG_ARM64=y
+CONFIG_ARCH_QCOM=y
+CONFIG_OF=y
+
+# SCSI block layer / Qualcomm UFS host
+# ACK .33 Kconfig: SCSI selects hidden SCSI_DMA when HAS_DMA (provided by
+# arm64); SCSI_UFSHCD depends on SCSI + SCSI_DMA and selects PM_DEVFREQ.
+# PM_DEVFREQ in turn selects hidden PM_OPP. Do not assign hidden dependency
+# symbols directly; let the real Kconfig selection chain resolve them.
+CONFIG_BLOCK=y
+CONFIG_SCSI=y
+CONFIG_BLK_DEV_SD=y
+CONFIG_SCSI_UFSHCD=y
+CONFIG_SCSI_UFSHCD_PLATFORM=y
+CONFIG_SCSI_UFS_QCOM=y
+
+# Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY
+CONFIG_GENERIC_PHY=y
+CONFIG_PHY_QCOM_QMP=y
+CONFIG_PHY_QCOM_QMP_UFS=y
+
+# SM8250 GCC supplies UFS clocks and the UFS_PHY_GDSC power domain.
+# SM_GCC_8250 selects hidden QCOM_GDSC; QCOM_GDSC selects PM_GENERIC_DOMAINS
+# when PM=y, while PM_GENERIC_DOMAINS_OF is auto-enabled with OF.
+# RPMh clock controller supplies RPMH_CXO_CLK referenced by the UFS node.
+CONFIG_COMMON_CLK=y
+CONFIG_COMMON_CLK_QCOM=y
+CONFIG_QCOM_CLK_RPMH=y
+CONFIG_SM_GCC_8250=y
+CONFIG_RESET_CONTROLLER=y
+CONFIG_PM=y
+
+# The ACK SM8250 UFS node declares two ICC paths (ufs-ddr, cpu-ufs).
+# INTERCONNECT_QCOM_SM8250 selects its RPMh and BCM-voter helpers; those
+# remain built-in because the UFS consumer must resolve them during probe.
+# The SM8250 interconnect driver selects its RPMh + BCM-voter backends.
+CONFIG_INTERCONNECT=y
+CONFIG_INTERCONNECT_QCOM=y
+CONFIG_INTERCONNECT_QCOM_SM8250=y
+
+# RPMh regulator provider for the HOS4.3 PM8150 UFS rails.
+CONFIG_QCOM_COMMAND_DB=y
+CONFIG_QCOM_RPMH=y
+CONFIG_QCOM_RPMHPD=y
+CONFIG_REGULATOR=y
+CONFIG_REGULATOR_QCOM_RPMH=y
+
+# UFS Host has apps_smmu stream IDs in the ACK SM8250 DTSI.
+# ARM_SMMU_QCOM is def_tristate y inside if ARM_SMMU when ARCH_QCOM=y and
+# selects QCOM_SCM; IOMMU_DMA and OF_IOMMU are architecture/OF-derived.
+# SCSI_UFS_QCOM requires GENERIC_MSI_IRQ. Do not assign this hidden
+# bool directly: arm64 selects ARM_GIC_V3 and selects ARM_GIC_V3_ITS when
+# PCI=y; ARM_GIC_V3_ITS selects GENERIC_MSI_IRQ. The pinned GKI base has PCI=y.
+CONFIG_IOMMU_SUPPORT=y
+CONFIG_ARM_SMMU=y
+# ARM_SMMU_QCOM is def_tristate y under ARM_SMMU && ARCH_QCOM;
+# its Kconfig selects QCOM_SCM automatically.
+
+# The Host's explicit UFS_PHY_GDSC power-domain is supplied by SM_GCC_8250.
+# Separately, ufs_opp_table contains required-opps references to
+# rpmhpd_opp_low_svs / rpmhpd_opp_nom. Keep RPMhPD built-in for this OPP path.
+# ROUND11's HOS4.3 ARC parent/proxy graph is vendor-specific; do not translate
+# its *-parent-supply or proxy-supply properties into PM8150 VRM supply links.
+# ACK uses the upstream SM8250 rpmhpd/OPP model for performance-level votes.
+#
+# SPMI_MSM_PMIC_ARB / MFD_SPMI_PMIC / PMIC SPMI pinctrl are deferred:
+# this minimal DTS does not include PM8150 SPMI GPIO/PON peripherals. The
+# UFS rail providers are under apps_rsc and use RPMh, not the SPMI arbiter.
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Android first-stage mount support — confirmed baseline + pending AVB/filesystem
+#
+# HOS4.3 super.img contains the Android logical partitions (system/vendor/odm/
+# cust/hw_product). Android first-stage maps logical partitions through the
+# device-mapper linear target. In this ACK source, dm-linear is part of
+# dm-mod; there is NO CONFIG_DM_LINEAR symbol.
+CONFIG_BLK_DEV_DM=y
+#
+# ROUND4 confirmed EROFS filesystem signatures on vendor and odm logical
+# partition images. First-stage must mount these before switching root, so
+# keep EROFS built-in until a compatible ramdisk module tree is proven.
+CONFIG_EROFS_FS=y
+#
+# Android first-stage init can load pre-mount drivers from /lib/modules when
+# the initramfs contains a kernel-release/page-size matching module directory,
+# modules.dep/softdep/alias/options and modules.load. ROUND10 ramdisk contents
+# are still unread, and DBY-W09's legacy ABL separate-ramdisk composition is
+# not yet proven to expose this exact layout. Therefore UFS/QMP stays built-in.
+#
+# The pinned ACK gki_defconfig already has CONFIG_DM_VERITY=y and
+# CONFIG_DM_VERITY_FEC=y, both built-in. Keep that inherited support.
+# This proves kernel capability only: ROUND12 AVB footer/vbmeta descriptor
+# inspection remains BLOCKED, so actual hashtree/FEC use and exact fstab
+# options are still UNKNOWN. Do not infer runtime AVB policy from config.
+#
+# Do not enable other filesystem drivers until the corresponding partition
+# signatures and first-stage fstab types are known:
+# CONFIG_EXT4_FS=y
+# CONFIG_F2FS_FS=y
+#
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Deferred board / feature drivers:
+# - Vendor HOS4.3 RPMh ARC groups: ACK's qcom-rpmh-regulator currently binds
+#   VRM/XOB only. ROUND22 defines an ARC-capable port as future work; it needs
+#   Command DB AUX voltage-level mapping, active/sleep aggregation, ARC
+#   enable-as-level-zero semantics, resource/parent links, and ACK rpmh API
+#   adaptation. New provider must be a direct apps_rsc child because ACK
+#   rpmh_write() resolves its RSC from dev->parent. Do NOT add vendor ARC
+#   nodes or invent a Kconfig symbol yet.
+# - Vendor HOS4.3 proxy-supply groups: ROUND22 found ACK has no
+#   REGULATOR_PROXY_CONSUMER symbol/source/core hook. The six proxy-supply
+#   phandles are known, but local proxy-consumer-enable/voltage/current
+#   flags have not been verified. Do NOT add proxy consumer behavior until
+#   those flags and whether UFS boot requires the proxy votes are established.
+# - SPMI PMIC MFD / PMIC arbiter / PMIC pinctrl: no SPMI consumers enabled yet.
+# - PINCTRL_SM8250: add when board GPIO/pinctrl consumers are enabled.
+# - GENI UART / console: ACK distinguishes qcom,geni-debug-uart (ttyMSM / earlycon) from
+#   qcom,geni-uart (ttyHS); uart2 is the debug node, uart6 the regular UART. The
+#   HOS androidboot.console property and earlycon key do not yet prove physical mapping.
+# - panel / THP / WLAN / BT / audio / camera / USB-C / DP: later stages.

From 59a2516bc9ef91799d8b9da3206206726f74f6de Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: hhdy <103477680+hhdy@users.noreply.github.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 18:48:33 +0800
Subject: [PATCH 2/3] dt-bindings: regulator: document qcom proxy consumer
 properties

Declare proxy-supply on the RPMh regulator provider node, plus
qcom,proxy-consumer-enable, qcom,proxy-consumer-current and
qcom,proxy-consumer-voltage on the regulator child nodes.

The child schema keeps unevaluatedProperties false, so an undeclared
qcom,proxy-consumer-* property is still rejected rather than silently
accepted.

Signed-off-by: hhdy <103477680+hhdy@users.noreply.github.com>
---
 .../regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.yaml        | 27 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 27 insertions(+)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.yaml
index 4c5b0629aa3e..9eade129be07 100644
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.yaml
@@ -110,6 +110,13 @@ properties:
         strictly lower power state.
     $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/flag
 
+  proxy-supply:
+    description: |
+        Phandle to the regulator child node that receives the temporary
+        boot time proxy consumer requests described by the
+        qcom,proxy-consumer-* properties of that child.  The requests are
+        withdrawn again at late_initcall_sync.
+
   vdd-flash-supply:
     description: Input supply phandle of flash.
 
@@ -130,6 +137,26 @@ patternProperties:
     $ref: regulator.yaml#
     unevaluatedProperties: false
     description: smps/ldo regulator nodes(s).
+    properties:
+      qcom,proxy-consumer-enable:
+        description: |
+            Boolean flag which requests that the boot time proxy consumer
+            keeps this regulator enabled until late_initcall_sync.
+        $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/flag
+
+      qcom,proxy-consumer-current:
+        description: |
+            Minimum current in microamperes requested by the boot time
+            proxy consumer.  Absent or zero means no current request.
+        $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/uint32
+
+      qcom,proxy-consumer-voltage:
+        description: |
+            Minimum and maximum voltage in microvolts requested by the
+            boot time proxy consumer.  Absent means no voltage request.
+        $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/uint32-array
+        minItems: 2
+        maxItems: 2
     dependencies:
       regulator-allow-set-load: [ regulator-allowed-modes ]

+++ b/arch/arm64/configs/dby_w09_storage_first.fragment

Subject: [PATCH 2/3] dt-bindings: regulator: document child-scoped
 proxy-supply

Declare proxy-supply on the regulator child nodes, so a child can name
the regulator that receives its own temporary boot proxy request (for
a self-targeting mapping, the phandle points at the child itself), and
extend the provider-level proxy-supply description to document that the
provider-level (legacy group) mapping must not be mixed with the
child-scoped mapping on one provider.  Consistent with every other
-supply declaration, the phandle type is conveyed by description only:
the dtschema meta-schema restricts *-supply properties to the
description and deprecated keys.

The child schema keeps unevaluatedProperties false, so undeclared
qcom,proxy-consumer-* properties are still rejected.

Signed-off-by: hhdy <103477680+hhdy@users.noreply.github.com>

 1 file changed, 17 insertions(+)

@@ -117,6 +117,12 @@ properties:
         qcom,proxy-consumer-* properties of that child.  The requests are
         withdrawn again at late_initcall_sync.
 
+        This provider-level declaration is the legacy group mapping: it
+        resolves one proxy target shared by every proxy request made on
+        this provider.  A provider-level proxy-supply and a child-level
+        proxy-supply must not be mixed on one provider; the kernel
+        rejects that combination instead of silently picking one.
+
   vdd-flash-supply:
     description: Input supply phandle of flash.
 
@@ -138,6 +144,17 @@ patternProperties:
     unevaluatedProperties: false
     description: smps/ldo regulator nodes(s).
     properties:
+      proxy-supply:
+        description: |
+            Phandle to the regulator that receives this child's temporary
+            boot time proxy consumer requests described by the
+            qcom,proxy-consumer-* properties of this child.  For a
+            self-targeting mapping this is a phandle to this child node
+            itself, which lets two children of one flattened provider
+            node vote on two different regulators.  The requests are
+            withdrawn again at late_initcall_sync.  Must not be combined
+            with a provider-level proxy-supply on the same provider.
+

         description: |
             Boolean flag which requests that the boot time proxy consumer
